purpose: Say an expected action has not happened yet.
keywords: まだ + て-form + いません.
I have not bought the ticket yet.
The teacher has not arrived yet.
I have not seen that film yet.
formation: まだ + て-form + いません.
restrictions: The action remains pending; this is not a statement that it will never happen.
mistake: Use まだ with a negative result state to express not yet.
